entrypoints.description: Repository-owned core orchestration composes preserved-source integrity, Grounded Evidence and optional Reality; v2 accepts a transport-neutral prepared material root.

Thin CAP-0007 trajectory composition delegates to the existing Evidence, Reality, Judgment, Outcome and typed replay owners and adds fail-closed phase/acceptance/no-rewrite gates without duplicating their semantics.
The core longcycle research command accepts a transport-neutral material root for v2 while retaining --source-pack only for legacy v1 replay.
Campaign-agnostic CLI executes one declared Evidence -> optional Reality/Judgment/Outcome -> sealed replay trajectory from a prepared material root.

extension_seams: Route researcher/task invocation adapters through the same orchestration and trajectory contracts rather than campaign-specific workflow logic.
Add a bounded execution phase only when another existing capability already owns the phase semantics; CAP-0007 composes and gates rather than reimplements.

Historical-recovery discovery stays upstream in CAP-0006; compose only source material that CAP-0001/CAP-0002 have truthfully preserved and grounded. Raw-file materialization is optional unless byte-level/source-format verification is itself claim-relevant.
Add researcher-readable output/presentation after typed CAP-0005 replay rather than changing knowledge-cutoff filtering in the orchestration layer.

guards.description: Contract tests prove core v2 orchestration verifies prepared source representations without requiring Release/source-pack transport.
Legacy v1 source-pack replay remains hash-checked and fail-closed without becoming the v2 default.
Trajectory contract rejects rewriting an already-known typed Judgment in a later replay snapshot while permitting later Outcome rows to appear separately.
Trajectory contract fails closed if any typed replay row has known_at later than its declared historical cutoff.
Real PostgreSQL proof run 32640720602 executed the generic contract over BLENREP through Grounded Evidence, Reality, contemporaneous Judgment, related Outcome and three no-lookahead replay cutoffs.

non_goals: Owning GitHub Release/Drive transport restoration or PDF download machinery.
Reimplementing Grounded Evidence, Reality reconciliation, Judgment identity/precision, Outcome comparability or CAP-0005 knowledge-cutoff semantics inside workflow/CLI.
Owning memory-first historical discovery or treating one execution entrypoint as the whole historical-research lifecycle.
Requiring raw source packs when claim-relevant content is already truthfully content_verified under CAP-0001/CAP-0002.
Campaign-specific branches, product ids, fact keys or replay cutoffs in generic runner code.
purpose: Own campaign-agnostic execution-stage composition from a verified local material root through Grounded Evidence and, when declared, existing Reality, contemporaneous Judgment, later Outcome and sealed point-in-time replay executors. CAP-0007 owns composition, phase ordering, acceptance gates, immutable-path checks and portable receipts; it delegates source truthfulness to CAP-0001/2, Reality to CAP-0003, Judgment/Outcome to CAP-0004 and historical visibility to CAP-0005. Research-orchestration/v2 remains transport-neutral; legacy v1 source-pack replay remains compatibility only.
revisit_when: Only replace if source identity, representation integrity, repair auditability, fail-closed phase composition, immutable guards, typed no-lookahead delegation and portable receipts remain one campaign-agnostic execution contract without absorbing historical discovery, transport, Reality/Judgment/Outcome or replay semantics from their existing owners.
title: Fail-closed research and epistemic-trajectory orchestration
